notes: The free level is now the basics in both courses, ten lessons each: the letters and how to read them, greetings through the day, introductions, the numbers, yes and no, and the question words. In Croatian the grammar that used to fill it, genders, pronouns, verb endings and the first two cases, has moved up into A1 where it belongs. In Portuguese the foundation lessons have moved down into the free level and the everyday phrases now open A1. No lesson was lost and nothing you have studied has gone anywhere, it is only ordered better.
